contentPattern.structure: two columns: rich-text (heading/list/CTA) beside image + text

suitableFor: why-choose-us panels (bullet list beside a supporting image)
app/product promo splits (screenshot beside feature list + CTA)
award/callout blocks (copy beside a badge image)
notSuitableFor: full-bleed hero banners with background images (use hero-banner)
repeating card grids of 3+ items (use cards variants)
